title: The Descendants of the Flame and Yellow Emperors
synopsis: Why do the Chinese people claim to be descendants of the Flame and Yellow Emperors?

fullText.simplified:
“炎黄子孙”的故事

    很久以前，在中国古代传说中，有两个非常强大的部落。一个是炎帝领导的部落，另一个是黄帝领导的部落。炎帝和黄帝都是中国古代传说中的重要人物，被认为是华夏民族的始祖。而在他们的时代，还有另一个非常强大的部落，叫做蚩尤部落。黄帝与蚩尤的战争是那个时代最著名的战争之一，也正是这场战争影响了后来的中国历史。
    蚩尤是一个非常强大的战士，他可以呼风唤雨。他的力量很大，很多人都害怕他，因为他太厉害了。
    黄帝知道蚩尤很强大，所以他请来了一个聪明的人，叫风后。风后给黄帝做了一个指南车，这个车总是指向南方。这样，黄帝和他的士兵就不会在暴风雨中迷路。
    黄帝和蚩尤的战争在一片大草原上发生。蚩尤用他的魔法，让天空变得黑暗，雷声很大。黄帝的士兵不知道该怎么办，他们很害怕，整个战场变得很乱。这时候，黄帝请来了应龙。它是一条神龙，可以控制风雨。应龙帮助黄帝驱散了蚩尤的风暴，天空变得晴朗了。黄帝的士兵开始反击，他们变得更勇敢了。
    最后，黄帝战胜了蚩尤，结束了这场战争。黄帝成为了整个中国的首领，他带领人们过上了和平的生活。经过这场战争，炎帝和黄帝的部落逐渐融合，形成了后来华夏民族的起源。因此，中国人常说自己是“炎黄子孙”，意思是他们是炎帝和黄帝的后代，是中华民族的传承者。
    黄帝与蚩尤的故事不仅展示了勇气和力量的重要性，更强调了智慧和团结的力量，这些都是中华民族的核心价值观。
fullText.traditional:
“炎黃子孫”的故事

    很久以前，在中國古代傳說中，有兩個非常強大的部落。一個是炎帝領導的部落，另一個是黃帝領導的部落。炎帝和黃帝都是中國古代傳說中的重要人物，被認為是華夏民族的始祖。而在他們的時代，還有另一個非常強大的部落，叫做蚩尤部落。黃帝與蚩尤的戰爭是那個時代最著名的戰爭之一，也正是這場戰爭影響了後來的中國歷史。
    蚩尤是一個非常強大的戰士，他可以呼風喚雨。他的力量很大，很多人都害怕他，因為他太厲害了。
    黃帝知道蚩尤很強大，所以他請來了一個聰明的人，叫風後。風後給黃帝做了一個指南車，這個車總是指向南方。這樣，黃帝和他的士兵就不會在暴風雨中迷路。
    黃帝和蚩尤的戰爭在一片大草原上發生。蚩尤用他的魔法，讓天空變得黑暗，雷聲很大。黃帝的士兵不知道該怎麼辦，他們很害怕，整個戰場變得很亂。這時候，黃帝請來了應龍。它是一條神龍，可以控制風雨。應龍幫助黃帝驅散了蚩尤的風暴，天空變得晴朗了。黃帝的士兵開始反擊，他們變得更勇敢了。
    最後，黃帝戰勝了蚩尤，結束了這場戰爭。黃帝成為了整個中國的首領，他帶領人們過上了和平的生活。經過這場戰爭，炎帝和黃帝的部落逐漸融合，形成了後來華夏民族的起源。因此，中國人常說自己是“炎黃子孫”，意思是他們是炎帝和黃帝的後代，是中華民族的傳承者。
    黃帝與蚩尤的故事不僅展示了勇氣和力量的重要性，更強調了智慧和團結的力量，這些都是中華民族的核心價值觀。

sentences.english: The Story of the “Descendants of the Flame and Yellow Emperors”

sentences.simplified: 很久以前，在中国古代传说中，有两个非常强大的部落。
sentences.traditional: 很久以前，在中國古代傳說中，有兩個非常強大的部落。
sentences.pinyin: hěn jiǔ yǐ qián zài zhōng guó gǔ dài chuán shuō zhōng yǒu liǎng ge fēi cháng qiáng dà de bù luò

sentences.simplified: 一个是炎帝领导的部落，另一个是黄帝领导的部落。
sentences.traditional: 一個是炎帝領導的部落，另一個是黃帝領導的部落。
sentences.pinyin: yí ge shì yán dì lǐng dǎo de bù luò lìng yí ge shì huáng dì lǐng dǎo de bù luò
sentences.english: A long time ago, in ancient Chinese legends, there were two very powerful tribes.

sentences.simplified: 炎帝和黄帝都是中国古代传说中的重要人物，
sentences.traditional: 炎帝和黃帝都是中國古代傳說中的重要人物，
sentences.pinyin: yán dì hé huáng dì dōu shì zhōng guó gǔ dài chuán shuō zhōng de zhòng yào rén wù
sentences.english: One was a tribe led by the Flame Emperor, and the other was a tribe led by the Yellow Emperor.

sentences.simplified: 被认为是华夏民族的始祖。
sentences.traditional: 被認為是華夏民族的始祖。
sentences.pinyin: bèi rèn wéi shì huá xià mín zú de shǐ zǔ
sentences.english: The Flame Emperor and Yellow Emperor are both important figures in ancient Chinese legends.

sentences.simplified: 而在他们的时代，还有另一个非常强大的部落，叫做蚩尤部落。
sentences.traditional: 而在他們的時代，還有另一個非常強大的部落，叫做蚩尤部落。
sentences.pinyin: ér zài tā men de shí dài hái yǒu lìng yí ge fēi cháng qiáng dà de bù luò jiào zuò chī yóu bù luò
sentences.english: They are considered to be the ancestors of the Chinese nation.

sentences.simplified: 黄帝与蚩尤的战争是那个时代最著名的战争之一，
sentences.traditional: 黃帝與蚩尤的戰爭是那個時代最著名的戰爭之一，
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì yǔ chī yóu de zhàn zhēng shì nà ge shí dài zuì zhù míng de zhàn zhēng zhī yī
sentences.english: In their era, there was another very powerful tribe called the Chiyou tribe.

sentences.simplified: 也正是这场战争影响了后来的中国历史。
sentences.traditional: 也正是這場戰爭影響了後來的中國歷史。
sentences.pinyin: yě zhèng shì zhè cháng zhàn zhēng yǐng xiǎng le hòu lái de zhōng guó lì shǐ
sentences.english: The battle between the Yellow Emperor and Chiyou was one of the most famous battles of that era.
It was this battle that influenced the later history of China.

sentences.simplified: 蚩尤是一个非常强大的战士，他可以呼风唤雨。
sentences.traditional: 蚩尤是一個非常強大的戰士，他可以呼風喚雨。
sentences.pinyin: chī yóu shì yí ge fēi cháng qiáng dà de zhàn shì tā kě yǐ hū fēng huàn yǔ

sentences.simplified: 他的力量很大，很多人都害怕他，因为他太厉害了。
sentences.traditional: 他的力量很大，很多人都害怕他，因為他太厲害了。
sentences.pinyin: tā de lì liang hěn dà hěn duō rén dōu hài pà tā yīn wèi tā tài lì hai le
sentences.english: Chiyou was a very powerful warrior. He could summon wind and rain.
He had great strength, and many people were afraid of him because he was so formidable.

sentences.simplified: 黄帝知道蚩尤很强大，所以他请来了一个聪明的人，叫风后。
sentences.traditional: 黃帝知道蚩尤很強大，所以他請來了一個聰明的人，叫風後。
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì zhī dào chī yóu hěn qiáng dà suǒ yǐ tā qǐng lái le yí ge cōng ming de rén jiào fēng hòu

sentences.simplified: 风后给黄帝做了一个指南车，这个车总是指向南方。
sentences.traditional: 風後給黃帝做了一個指南車，這個車總是指向南方。
sentences.pinyin: fēng hòu gěi huáng dì zuò le yí ge zhǐ nán chē zhè ge chē zǒng shì zhǐ xiàng nán fāng
sentences.english: The Yellow Emperor knew that Chiyou was very powerful, so he requested the presence of a wise person named Fenghou.

sentences.simplified: 这样，黄帝和他的士兵就不会在暴风雨中迷路。
sentences.traditional: 這樣，黃帝和他的士兵就不會在暴風雨中迷路。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng huáng dì hé tā de shì bīng jiù bú huì zài bào fēng yǔ zhōng mí lù
sentences.english: Fenghou made a south-pointing chariot for the Yellow Emperor. This chariot always pointed to the south.
This way, the Yellow Emperor and his soldiers would not get lost in the storm.

sentences.simplified: 黄帝和蚩尤的战争在一片大草原上发生。
sentences.traditional: 黃帝和蚩尤的戰爭在一片大草原上發生。
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì hé chī yóu de zhàn zhēng zài yí piàn dà cǎo yuán shang fā shēng

sentences.simplified: 蚩尤用他的魔法，让天空变得黑暗，雷声很大。
sentences.traditional: 蚩尤用他的魔法，讓天空變得黑暗，雷聲很大。
sentences.pinyin: chī yóu yòng tā de mó fǎ ràng tiān kōng biàn de hēi àn léi shēng hěn dà
sentences.english: The battle between the Yellow Emperor and Chiyou took place on a vast grassland.

sentences.simplified: 黄帝的士兵不知道该怎么办，
sentences.traditional: 黃帝的士兵不知道該怎麼辦，
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì de shì bīng bù zhī dào gāi zěn me bàn
sentences.english: Chiyou used his magic to make the sky dark and the thunder loud.

sentences.simplified: 他们很害怕，整个战场变得很乱。
sentences.traditional: 他們很害怕，整個戰場變得很亂。
sentences.pinyin: tā men hěn hài pà zhěng ge zhàn chǎng biàn de hěn luàn
sentences.english: The soldiers of the Yellow Emperor did not know what to do.

sentences.simplified: 这时候，黄帝请来了应龙。
sentences.traditional: 這時候，黃帝請來了應龍。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou huáng dì qǐng lái le yìng lóng
sentences.english: They were very scared, and the entire battlefield became chaotic.

sentences.simplified: 它是一条神龙，可以控制风雨。
sentences.traditional: 它是一條神龍，可以控制風雨。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì yì tiáo shén lóng kě yǐ kòng zhì fēng yǔ
sentences.english: At this moment, the Yellow Emperor requested the presence of Yinglong.

sentences.simplified: 应龙帮助黄帝驱散了蚩尤的风暴，天空变得晴朗了。
sentences.traditional: 應龍幫助黃帝驅散了蚩尤的風暴，天空變得晴朗了。
sentences.pinyin: yìng lóng bāng zhù huáng dì qū sàn le chī yóu de fēng bào tiān kōng biàn de qíng lǎng le
sentences.english: It was a divine dragon, capable of controlling wind and rain.

sentences.simplified: 黄帝的士兵开始反击，他们变得更勇敢了。
sentences.traditional: 黃帝的士兵開始反擊，他們變得更勇敢了。
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì de shì bīng kāi shǐ fǎn jī tā men biàn de gèng yǒng gǎn le
sentences.english: Yinglong helped the Yellow Emperor disperse Chiyou’s storm, and the sky became clear.
The Yellow Emperor’s soldiers began to counterattack, and they became braver.

sentences.simplified: 最后，黄帝战胜了蚩尤，结束了这场战争。
sentences.traditional: 最後，黃帝戰勝了蚩尤，結束了這場戰爭。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu huáng dì zhàn shèng le chī yóu jié shù le zhè cháng zhàn zhēng

sentences.simplified: 黄帝成为了整个中国的首领，他带领人们过上了和平的生活。
sentences.traditional: 黃帝成為了整個中國的首領，他帶領人們過上了和平的生活。
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì chéng wéi le zhěng ge zhōng guó de shǒu lǐng tā dài lǐng rén men guò shàng le hé píng de shēng huó
sentences.english: In the end, the Yellow Emperor defeated Chiyou, ending the battle.

sentences.simplified: 经过这场战争，炎帝和黄帝的部落逐渐融合，
sentences.traditional: 經過這場戰爭，炎帝和黃帝的部落逐漸融合，
sentences.pinyin: jīng guò zhè cháng zhàn zhēng yán dì hé huáng dì de bù luò zhú jiàn róng hé
sentences.english: The Yellow Emperor became the leader of all of China. He led the people to live a peaceful life.

sentences.simplified: 形成了后来华夏民族的起源。
sentences.traditional: 形成了後來華夏民族的起源。
sentences.pinyin: xíng chéng le hòu lái huá xià mín zú de qǐ yuán
sentences.english: After this battle, the tribes of the Flame Emperor and the Yellow Emperor gradually merged, ..

sentences.simplified: 因此，中国人常说自己是“炎黄子孙”，
sentences.traditional: 因此，中國人常說自己是“炎黃子孫”，
sentences.pinyin: yīn cǐ zhōng guó rén cháng shuō zì jǐ shì yán huáng zǐ sūn
sentences.english: .. laying the foundation for what would become the Huaxia people.

sentences.simplified: 意思是他们是炎帝和黄帝的后代，是中华民族的传承者。
sentences.traditional: 意思是他們是炎帝和黃帝的後代，是中華民族的傳承者。
sentences.pinyin: yì si shì tā men shì yán dì hé huáng dì de hòu dài shì zhōng huá mín zú de chuán chéng zhě
sentences.english: Therefore, Chinese people often refer to themselves as “descendants of the Flame and Yellow Emperors”.
This means they are the descendants of the Flame Emperor and the Yellow Emperor, the inheritors of the Chinese nation.

sentences.simplified: 黄帝与蚩尤的故事不仅展示了勇气和力量的重要性，
sentences.traditional: 黃帝與蚩尤的故事不僅展示了勇氣和力量的重要性，
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì yǔ chī yóu de gù shi bù jǐn zhǎn shì le yǒng qì hé lì liang de zhòng yào xìng

sentences.simplified: 更强调了智慧和团结的力量，这些都是中华民族的核心价值观。
sentences.traditional: 更強調了智慧和團結的力量，這些都是中華民族的核心價值觀。
sentences.pinyin: gèng qiáng diào le zhì huì hé tuán jié de lì liang zhè xiē dōu shì zhōng huá mín zú de hé xīn jià zhí guān
sentences.english: The story of the Yellow Emperor and Chiyou not only demonstrates the importance of courage and strength, ..

sentence_translations: The Story of the “Descendants of the Flame and Yellow Emperors”
A long time ago, in ancient Chinese legends, there were two very powerful tribes.
One was a tribe led by the Flame Emperor, and the other was a tribe led by the Yellow Emperor.
The Flame Emperor and Yellow Emperor are both important figures in ancient Chinese legends.
They are considered to be the ancestors of the Chinese nation.
In their era, there was another very powerful tribe called the Chiyou tribe.
The battle between the Yellow Emperor and Chiyou was one of the most famous battles of that era.
It was this battle that influenced the later history of China.
Chiyou was a very powerful warrior. He could summon wind and rain.
He had great strength, and many people were afraid of him because he was so formidable.
The Yellow Emperor knew that Chiyou was very powerful, so he requested the presence of a wise person named Fenghou.
Fenghou made a south-pointing chariot for the Yellow Emperor. This chariot always pointed to the south.
This way, the Yellow Emperor and his soldiers would not get lost in the storm.
The battle between the Yellow Emperor and Chiyou took place on a vast grassland.
Chiyou used his magic to make the sky dark and the thunder loud.
The soldiers of the Yellow Emperor did not know what to do.
They were very scared, and the entire battlefield became chaotic.
At this moment, the Yellow Emperor requested the presence of Yinglong.
It was a divine dragon, capable of controlling wind and rain.
Yinglong helped the Yellow Emperor disperse Chiyou’s storm, and the sky became clear.
The Yellow Emperor’s soldiers began to counterattack, and they became braver.
In the end, the Yellow Emperor defeated Chiyou, ending the battle.
The Yellow Emperor became the leader of all of China. He led the people to live a peaceful life.
After this battle, the tribes of the Flame Emperor and the Yellow Emperor gradually merged, ..
.. laying the foundation for what would become the Huaxia people.
Therefore, Chinese people often refer to themselves as “descendants of the Flame and Yellow Emperors”.
This means they are the descendants of the Flame Emperor and the Yellow Emperor, the inheritors of the Chinese nation.
The story of the Yellow Emperor and Chiyou not only demonstrates the importance of courage and strength, ..
.. it also emphasizes the power of wisdom and unity, which are core values of the Chinese nation.
